name: product-grid-reveal
title: Product Grid Reveal
description: A mosaic of 6 or 9 product tiles, each with a name and a price, flips in with a stagger. One tile then scales up as the highlight and gets a Terlaris badge while the rest dim. Tiles show a drawn placeholder or your own images.
useWhen: Showing a range of products at once, then pointing at the best seller.
A weekly menu, a catalogue page, a new-arrivals teaser.
avoidWhen: One product with a big price: use price-drop.
A priced list read line by line: use menu-price-board.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Line above the grid. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Products
variables.description: One per line, Name|Price. 6 or fewer lines make a 6-tile grid, more make 9.

variables.label: Highlight
variables.description: Which tile (1 = first) scales up. 0 for none.

variables.label: Images
variables.description: Optional image URLs, one per line in tile order. Empty tiles stay drawn.

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: Badge and highlight outline: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
